noaskevitch: Nils Noaskevitch reported to S-F2 with a photograph gone soft at the edges sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Nils Noaskevitch took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
zde_schu: After 4 days of war, R-F22 had a place for everything. On Day 5, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Silas Schu.
